name: lmark
description: A modular Windows 11 knowledge workspace with standard Markdown notes.
author: Codex

scripts.release:check: npm run privacy:audit && npm run release:validate
scripts.dist:dir: npm run privacy:audit && electron-builder --win dir -c build/electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:portable: npm run privacy:audit && electron-builder --win dir -c build/electron-builder.config.cjs && npm run release:portable
